description:
Practical home tips for seniors who want to stay comfortable, safe, and independent at home.

Senior Home Tips is a channel for older adults and for the families who help them with simple, low-cost ways to make everyday life at home easier. No expensive renovations, no complicated gadgets.

Every video covers real household problems: reaching things without bending or climbing, freeing up space in a small home, preventing falls and trip hazards, cutting food waste and household costs, dealing with moisture, odors and stubborn dirt, and keeping things working longer.

We cover senior home organization, aging-in-place ideas, kitchen and bathroom accessibility, decluttering, cleaning routines, home safety, and forgotten old-fashioned tricks that still work today.

Clear explanations. One idea at a time. Nothing you need a contractor for.
